abilities.name: natural-cure
abilities.effect: Cures any major status ailment upon switching out.

abilities.name: serene-grace
abilities.effect: Doubles the chance of moves' extra effects occurring.

abilities.name: healer
abilities.effect: Has a 30% chance of curing each adjacent ally of any major status ailment after each turn.

kanto.flavorText: A rare and elusive POKéMON that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to catch one.

original-johto.flavorText: People try to catch it for its extremely nutritious eggs, but it rarely can be found.

hoenn.flavorText: CHANSEY lay nutritionally excellent eggs every day. The eggs are so delicious, they are eagerly devoured by even those people who have lost their appetite.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: It lays several eggs a day and won’t share them with those who have evil in their hearts.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: A kindly Pokémon that lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.

updated-johto.flavorText: Being few in number and difficult to capture, it is said to bring happiness to the Trainer who catches it.

original-unova.flavorText: A kindly Pokémon that lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.

updated-unova.flavorText: A kindly Pokémon that lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.

kalos.flavorText: It lays several eggs a day. The eggs are apparently rich in nutrients and extremely delicious.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Chansey lays nutritionally excellent eggs on an everyday basis. The eggs are so delicious, they are easily and eagerly devoured by even those people who have lost their appetite.

original-alola.flavorText: Not only are these Pokémon fast runners, they’re also few in number, so anyone who finds one must be lucky indeed.

updated-alola.flavorText: Because the eggs on their bellies have been overharvested by people in the past, the Chansey population remains very small.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: A gentle and kindhearted Pokémon that shares its nutritious eggs if it sees an injured Pokémon.

swsh.flavorText: This species was once very slow. To protect their eggs from other creatures, these Pokémon became able to flee quickly.

pla.flavorText: This purehearted Pokémon shares its eggs with the injured.
